reserveReview.rationale: OpenEden documents cUSDO as the non-rebasing wrapped form of USDO and states that users can convert between the two at any time through the wrapper smart contract. This classification-only review applies immediate liquidity to the direct held USDO wrapper position, not to sale of USDO for dollars or to inherited Treasury portfolio settlement. At Ethereum block 26285193 on 2026-10-27, cUSDO 0xad55aebc9b8c03fc43cd9f62260391c13c23e7c0 asset() returned USDO 0x8238884ec9668ef77b90c6dff4d1a9f4f4823bfe, reconfirming the single-asset wrapper; the docs page still states users can convert between USDO and cUSDO at any time. No new weights are published, so the 100% single-slice basis is unchanged. It does not refresh producer allocation weights or observations.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current USDO reserve-asset weights and custodian shares are inherited from USDO and are not required to establish the direct 100% wrapper relationship.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: OpenEden identifies the wrapper contracts and states that the underlying USDO issuer is a Bermuda segregated accounts company, but does not publish a rehypothecation term for wrapper-held USDO or current provider shares. Rechecked 2026-10-20: the current cUSDO documentation and issuer-linked User Agreement dated 2026-10-14 do not establish a complete allocated custody chain for all native cUSDO paths and the inherited USDO reserve basket. The former whole-asset institutional-regulated custodyModel scalar is withdrawn to unknown, without denying the Ethereum on-chain wrapper relationship or BMA-supervised underlying issuance. Original custody review start is not renewed.
